name: Camp Addisone Boyce
operator_name: Girl Scouts of the Heart of the Hudson
description_short: Girl Scout day camp on a lake in Tomkins Cove for girls entering kindergarten to 12th grade, with weekly themed sessions by Girl Scout level where campers hike, swim, boat, fish, try archery and the low ropes course, and earn badges. Girls entering 6th grade and up can stay overnight on Thursdays.
refund_policy_summary: Sessions are refundable up to two weeks before they start, less the $75 non refundable deposit; no refunds after that.

sessions.name: Two week Junior and Cadette sessions, weeks 1 and 2
Two week Junior and Cadette sessions, weeks 3 and 4
Two week Junior and Cadette sessions, weeks 5 and 6

fees.name: Bus
fees.note: For campers who take the camp bus; routes announced before camp. Early registration discounts don't apply to bus fees.

notes: One week sessions are $450 for Daisies (entering K to 1), Brownies (2 to 3), Juniors (4 to 5), Cadettes (6 to 8) and Senior/Ambassador Super STARs (9 to 12); two week Junior and Cadette sessions are $895. The brochure's prices with busing are $550 a week ($1,095 two weeks), and $650 for Super STARs, which suggests a higher bus charge for that level. A $75 non refundable deposit per session goes toward tuition; balance due May 27. Early payment discounts of 15%, 10% or 5% ran January to April 16, 2026. Camperships for GSHH members (apply by April 15). Prior Girl Scout membership is not required. Monday to Friday, 8:15 am to 4 pm; campers bring lunch. Thursday campfire with cookout for grades 4 and 5 (pick up 9 pm), optional Thursday overnights for grades 6 and up.
